Examples: Hybrid working means two days in the office. | They adopted hybrid working permanently.

Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; introduce + hot-desking
Examples: Hot-desking saved rent and cost goodwill. | The floor was redesigned for hot-desking.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; rent/work from + a coworking space
Examples: She rents a desk in a coworking space. | Coworking spaces filled the empty shop units.

Definition: sự biệt phái (điều động tạm thời)
Pattern: danh từ đếm được; be on/a six-month + secondment
Examples: He is on secondment to the ministry. | A six-month secondment turned into a transfer.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; take/be on + a sabbatical
Examples: She took a sabbatical to finish the book. | Sabbaticals are unpaid after the first term.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; a relocation + package/allowance
Examples: The relocation package covers three months of rent. | Relocation was the condition of the promotion.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; apply for/hold + a work permit
Examples: He holds a work permit valid for two years. | Applying for a work permit takes four months.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được hoặc không; breach/tighten + labour law
Examples: Labour law was tightened after the fire. | The agency breached labour law repeatedly.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; sign/a clause in + an employment contract
Examples: Read the employment contract before you sign it. | One clause in the employment contract is unlawful.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; do/an unpaid + trial shift
Examples: Unpaid trial shifts are common in kitchens. | She did a trial shift on the Saturday.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; be approached by + a headhunter
Examples: A headhunter approached her twice that year. | Headhunters work only at the top of the scale.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; register with/use + a recruitment agency
Examples: He registered with three recruitment agencies. | The hospital uses a recruitment agency for night cover.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; attend/hold + a job fair
Examples: The college holds a job fair every February. | She attended the job fair and left with two interviews.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; sit/pass + an aptitude test
Examples: Every applicant sits an aptitude test first. | He passed the aptitude test but failed the interview.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; attend/a one-day + assessment centre
Examples: The assessment centre lasts a full day. | Candidates attend an assessment centre in groups of eight.

Definition: quy trình hội nhập nhân viên mới
Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; improve/an onboarding + process
Examples: Onboarding here takes a single afternoon. | Better onboarding cut early resignations by half.

Definition: phỏng vấn khi rời công ti
Pattern: danh từ đếm được; conduct/hold + an exit interview
Examples: Her exit interview changed nothing. | Exit interviews are held with every leaver.

Pattern: appoint + sb + as/to + N; thường bị động
Examples: She was appointed as acting head in July. | They appointed an outsider to the role.

Pattern: redeploy + sb + to + N
Examples: Forty staff were redeployed rather than dismissed. | The council redeployed her to the housing team.

Pattern: shadow + sb; cũng là danh từ job shadowing
Examples: New recruits shadow a senior nurse for a week. | He shadowed the duty manager every Friday.

Pattern: moonlight as + N
Examples: Several drivers moonlight as couriers. | She moonlighted as a tutor for two years.

Definition: học nghề mới, đào tạo lại
Pattern: retrain; retrain as + N
Examples: He retrained as an electrician at forty. | Miners were promised funds to retrain.

Pattern: headhunt + sb; thường bị động
Examples: She was headhunted by a rival firm. | They headhunt engineers straight out of the labs.

Pattern: knuckle down; knuckle down to + N
Examples: He knuckled down after the first warning. | The team knuckled down to the backlog.

Pattern: muck in; muck in with + sb
Examples: Everyone mucks in when a delivery arrives. | The manager mucked in with the cleaning.

Pattern: step up; step up to + N
Examples: Two juniors stepped up while she was ill. | He stepped up to the deputy role overnight.

Pattern: pitch in; pitch in with + N
Examples: Neighbours pitched in during the harvest. | Everyone pitched in with the stocktake.

Pattern: bow out; bow out of + N
Examples: She bowed out after the merger. | He bowed out of the race for chair.

Pattern: clock off; đối lập clock in
Examples: Nobody clocks off before the handover. | They clocked off at three on Fridays.

Pattern: take time off (work); tách được
Examples: She took time off after the funeral. | He has taken no time off since January.

Pattern: a salaried + N (post, employee)
Examples: A salaried post brought stability at last. | Salaried staff do not record their hours.

Pattern: casual + N (work, labour, staff)
Examples: Casual work pays the fare and little else. | The farm employs casual labour in August.

Pattern: part-time + N; cũng là trạng từ work part-time
Examples: Two part-time posts replaced one full job. | She works part-time while studying.

Pattern: full-time + N; cũng là trạng từ work full-time
Examples: He returned to full-time work in April. | Only full-time staff join the pension scheme.

Pattern: be made redundant
Examples: Ninety workers were made redundant. | She was made redundant three weeks before Christmas.

Pattern: be overworked; overworked and underpaid
Examples: The ward is overworked and understaffed. | Overworked staff make avoidable errors.

Pattern: be underpaid; badly underpaid
Examples: Carers remain badly underpaid. | She was underpaid for a year before noticing.

Definition: làm việc trực tiếp với khách hàng
Pattern: a client-facing + N (role, post)
Examples: Her first client-facing role terrified her. | Client-facing staff are trained for a fortnight.

Pattern: be/have + a baptism of fire
Examples: His first shift was a baptism of fire. | She had a baptism of fire in the complaints team.

Pattern: hit the ground running
Examples: He hit the ground running in his first week. | A good handover lets a successor hit the ground running.
